name: Apple PIM: Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, Mail
description: macOS-only. Wraps four native Swift CLIs (calendar-cli, reminder-cli, contacts-cli, mail-cli) you build locally from source via ./setup.sh — no binaries are downloaded by the registry. Grants the agent read/write access to Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, and Mail.app (including send/delete) once you approve the corresponding macOS TCC and Automation prompts.

apple-mail.label: Apple Mail
apple-mail.description: Polls the local Mail.app store and authorizes senders by DKIM/SPF authentication strength.

dmPolicy.description: Who may drive the agent. Default allowlist.

allowFrom.description: Addresses permitted to drive the agent. Policy only: authentication is proved separately via trustedSendersPath.

minIdentifierAuthentication.description: Minimum strength before an identifier may authorize a sender. 'asserted' requires the sender's domain to have authenticated; 'verified' additionally requires a per-sender expectedDkimDomains entry.

trustedSendersPath.description: Path to trusted-senders.json, carrying expectedDkimDomains and trustedAuthservIds.

selfAddresses.description: Addresses the agent sends as. Required: this is the inbound and outbound loop guard.

operatorAddresses.description: The operator's own addresses. Always permitted reply recipients.

egressAllowlist.description: Recipients the agent may originate mail to. Egress is default-deny without this.

mailbox.description: Mailbox to poll. Not always INBOX: mail is often archived on arrival.

pageSize.description: Messages read per cycle, oldest unprocessed first.

maxAgentRunsPerHour.description: Circuit breaker. Default-deny bounds who may drive the agent, not how much.

binDir.description: Path to Swift CLI binaries directory

profile.description: Default profile name for Apple PIM (Personal Information Manager) config

configDir.description: Default config directory for Apple PIM (Personal Information Manager)

mailAttachmentsConfig.description: Path to mail attachment policy JSON. Default: ~/.config/apple-pim/mail-attachments.json. Mail send/reply attachments are default-denied unless this file opts in with allowedRoots.

binDir.label: CLI Binary Directory
binDir.help: Path to the directory containing calendar-cli, reminder-cli, contacts-cli, mail-cli. Auto-detected from PATH if not set.

profile.label: Profile
profile.help: Config profile name for filtering calendars/lists/contacts. See ~/.config/apple-pim/profiles/.

configDir.label: Config Directory
configDir.help: Override the config root directory for Apple PIM (default: ~/.config/apple-pim/).

mailAttachmentsConfig.label: Mail Attachments Policy File
mailAttachmentsConfig.help: Mail send/reply attachments are default-denied. To allow attachments, point this at a JSON file with {"enabled": true, "allowedRoots": ["~/Downloads"]}. Even when enabled, paths in ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, etc. and files like id_rsa, *.pem, *secret* are always refused.
